dead_ends.approach: existence-based version echo of client protocolVersion in MCP initialize
dead_ends.why_failed: echoing arbitrary client strings (even 9999-12-31) misrepresents capability; clamp to the known-protocol set instead

learned.claim: v0.5.0 ships four distribution vehicles: doctrine_install (into any repo), doctrineos MCP server (any MCP agent), Claude Code plugin via marketplace.json, and the doctrineos wheel (publish human-gated).
Source-repo checks and consumer-repo checks are different lint families: plugin parity and CHANGELOG sync must skip where those files legitimately do not exist, or every consumer starts red.
A fixed bug class recurred in NEW code (CRLF rewrite, v0.3.0 D-2 class, reappeared in the installer as PD-5): regression tests guard old sites only - the reviewer sweep is what catches recurrence.
MCP serve loops must treat every stdin line as hostile: non-object JSON, batch arrays, deep nesting, and oversized lines all reached crash paths before hardening.
Remote wired to github.com/aroora-ai-labs/doctrine; push blocked at sandbox permission layer - the human pushes or approves.

next_actions: After push: create the GitHub release for v0.5.0 (human-gated); consider gold-record discipline for future doctrineos wheel publishes
